priority.dynamo_unsupported: Multi-node inference (Dynamo) does not support changing priority yet.
priority.workload_not_found: No Kueue Workload found for task {cr_name} (it may not have been submitted yet, or it has finished).
priority.task_finished: The task has finished, so its priority cannot be changed.
priority.note_workload: Updated the CR label and deleted Workload {name}. Kueue will recreate the Workload with the new priority.
priority.note_deployment: Updated the CR label and deleted Deployment {name} (the operator recreates it and the container restarts). Kueue will rebuild the Workload with the new priority.
